propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded; CREATE/UPDATE use built-in local_to_jira_status and inbound inverts jira_to_local_status with hardcoded rebar-status labels for blocked/cancelled, offering no echo-safe path for projects needing remap or collapse.

Outbound (forward) status mapping must become per-project config-driven via effective_status_map(project_key) that merges builtin ← default ← projects.<KEY> using S1 resolve_for_project, with map-or-drift behavior: unmapped statuses omit the status field (Jira unchanged) with a deduped drift alert.

Inbound rebar-status:<local> round-trip must generalize to support any config remap/collapse by stamping the label iff config.jira_to_local_status.get(target) != local, enabling lossless recovery without a reverse map.

Config-only remapped Jira status names must be tolerated by fetcher._known_jira_statuses and preflight_status_mapping by widening both to built-in ∪ mapping_config.declared_status_names, eliminating spurious warnings.
The duplicated _REBAR_STATUS_LABEL_TO_LOCAL literal across inbound modules must be retired for a single shared helper whose recovery vocab is derived from local status values, ensuring consistency.
repo_root must be threaded from run_differs through OutboundDiffConfig and _effective_status_map_for to read [mapping] config from the store root (not CWD), mirroring fetcher/preflight behavior.
